basic_profile.bio: Avid 3D printing enthusiast based in the Southeast USA. I started my journey into 3D printing about two years ago after getting inspired by a YouTube video on custom PC builds. I enjoy designing and printing parts for various DIY projects, especially anything related to PC modding. Besides printing, I'm also keen on technology discussions and occasionally delve into personal finance topics. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to explore my hobbies. Usually online during the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight. In a relationship with a fellow tech enthusiast who shares my interest in creative projects.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Industrial Design, which provided a strong foundation in CAD and 3D modeling. My expertise in 3D printing is largely self-taught, driven by countless hours spent experimenting with different materials and printer settings. My work in graphic design has honed my eye for detail and aesthetics, which I apply to my printing projects.
